name: npm-dev-button
displayName: NPM Dev Button for Status Bar
description: Status bar button that runs 'npm run dev' in a custom terminal and opens the server in your browser.

npmDevButton.command.description: Command executed when the button is clicked.

npmDevButton.workingDirectory.description: Subfolder (relative to the workspace folder) where the command runs. Useful in monorepos, e.g. 'apps/web'. Empty = workspace root.

npmDevButton.terminalIcon.description: Icon of the created terminal. ID of a codicon (https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html).

npmDevButton.terminalColor.description: Color of the created terminal. ID of a theme color (e.g. terminal.ansiGreen, terminal.ansiCyan, terminal.ansiMagenta).

npmDevButton.shellPath.description: Path to bash. Empty = 'bash' on Linux/macOS and the default profile on Windows (e.g. C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe).

npmDevButton.fallbackUrl.description: URL used when it cannot be detected from the terminal output.

npmDevButton.openBrowser.description: Open the default browser when the server is up.

npmDevButton.startupTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for the server to respond before giving up on opening the browser.
